#!/bin/sh
input=$(cat)

cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cwd')
model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name')
used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty')
echo "$input" | jq -c 'select(.rate_limits) | .rate_limits + {at: (now | todate)}' > "$HOME/.claude/orchestration/usage-now.json.tmp" 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$HOME/.claude/orchestration/usage-now.json.tmp" ] && mv "$HOME/.claude/orchestration/usage-now.json.tmp" "$HOME/.claude/orchestration/usage-now.json"

dir=$(basename "$cwd")

branch=""
if [ -d "$cwd/.git" ] || git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  branch=$(git -C "$cwd" symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)
fi

CYAN="\033[36m"
BLUE="\033[34m"
RED="\033[31m"
RESET="\033[0m"

if [ -n "$branch" ]; then
  printf "${CYAN}%s${RESET} ${BLUE}git:(${RED}%s${BLUE})${RESET} ${BLUE}[%s]${RESET}" "$dir" "$branch" "$model"
else
  printf "${CYAN}%s${RESET} ${BLUE}[%s]${RESET}" "$dir" "$model"
fi

if [ -n "$used" ]; then
  printf " ctx:%.0f%%" "$used"
fi
orchestration/usage-now.json
orchestration/usage-alert.sh
